text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Doooberrr!! Thank you for the 
absolute best runnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober-chan, you were amazing today too--!! 
You were so cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You've grown into one, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In that case, the next step is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (The trembling... has stopped...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Not just that. The cheers from the stands 
reached me so crystal clear――――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I just finished running... and yet power 
is surging through me...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is... my first time seeing anything 
like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha-what!? Wait, wait, wasn't 
Dober-chan smiling super brightly just 
now!?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text: —Uh oh. Tears are... starting to fall...

Welcoming back Mejiro Dober, who put on 
the most spectacular run—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"My body isn't trembling anymore. If 
anything, right now I—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled...! I've never felt like 
this before...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just itching... to run all-out in the 
next race... the Shuka Sho!"

Mejiro Dober embraced her fear and 
overcame it, showing tremendous growth...!
choice_data_list:
Let's run even better at the Shuka Sho 
than we did today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I'll carry this exact feeling 
into the Shuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Please keep believing in me 
just the same.
